about.title: Thoughtful systems.
about.body: I’m Parth — a software engineer who builds thoughtful products across the full stack. Currently a full-stack engineer on LX-Studio, Skillsoft’s AI-enabled authoring platform, I build the Skill Assessment module from assessment authoring and skill-based scoring to publishing custom benchmarks.
experience.label: Experience
job.skillsoft.point0: Own full-stack development of the Skill Assessment module in LX-Studio, from assessment creation through skill-based scoring to publishing.
job.skillsoft.point1: Build custom skill benchmarks and agentic workflows that guide authors through assessment creation.
job.skillsoft.point2: Refine authoring UX and integrate React interfaces with Python and Node.js services across the platform.
job.icims.point0: Developed Hiring Suite features for career sites that manage candidate applications end to end.
job.icims.point1: Designed REST APIs and external-service integrations with a focus on robustness, security, and data consistency.
job.icims.point2: Improved reliability through testing, profiling, and production issue resolution.
job.globallogic.point0: Developed reusable UI components for Ericsson white-label client deployments.
job.globallogic.point1: Contributed features, fixes, and test coverage to the iCIMS Hiring Suite.
